Products GIFT CARDS NEWS Contact Cart ( 0 ) Products GIFT CARDS NEWS Contact Cart ( 0 ) FELLBEAST FUZZ $ 200.00 - $ 250.00 Select option BLACKENED BLACK METAL CRACKLE BLACK custom color (Sold out) Add to cart THE FELLBEAST FUZZ is the LOUDEST and most dynamic fuzz I could possibly design using a Baxandall tone stack and notch filter midrange. From sludge to shoegaze, the range of tones is just as staggering as the amount of boosted output. You can absolutely slam the front end of an amp the most brutal fuzz imaginable. The FELLBEAST includes an impedance correction transformer because all Blackhawk fuzz pedals can be placed anywhere in your guitar chain. You never have to worry about buffers or active pickups getting in the way of your tone. /////////////////////////////////////////////// “PRE-ORDER” simply means it is made to order. You purchase and then I build as quickly as possible. Preorders take about two weeks but rarely can take up to four. Every pedal is made by hand for YOU. /////////////////////////////////////////////// FELLBEAST V2 update: Aside from a more symmetrical PCB layout there is now an additional Gate/Bias control (indicated with an "X"). This control doesn't actually affect the bias so much as it takes the negative feedback and allows you to increase/decrease it for an adjustable gated fuzz control. The audio affect of this is what other fuzzes would call a bias control. Higher settings are more "gated" "sputtery" or "zipper". Lower settings are thick and full and more articulate distortion. Videos are available on Instagram @blackhawkamps 🔱=gain V=volume T=treble M=midrange B=bass X=gate/bias All BLACKHAWK pedals and preamps are true bypass and standard “one spot style” 9v, Negative tip, 2.1mm barrel. 1 of 2 You might also like Previous Next PI π FUZZ: GREEN / BLACK RUSSIAN (90s) $ 190.00 - $ 220.00 VALKNUT BANDPASS DISTORTION V3 $ 200.00 - $ 220.00 MITHRANDIR OCTAVE FUZZ MKII (BARITONE / BASS) $ 250.00 - $ 260.00 Sold out Search Home Products Contact Cart ( 0 ) Bass Boost Distortion Drive Dynamics EQ Fuzz Modulation Octave Utility Pedals Double Pedals Preamplifiers Amplifiers Modified gear [[PRE-ORDER]] SALE Reverb GIFT CARDS NEWS About FAQ ENCLOSURE COLORS TERMS AND CONDITIONS Back to site

Controls: Volume, Mids, Gain, Treble, Bass, Depth. Preferred: Bass/Depth max; Volume 1 o'c; Mids 11:30 o'c. Basilisk Warm Mid Gain Fuzz — $200/$220. Tone, Mids, Bass, Volume, Gain. Preferred: Mids ~3 o'c; Tone 2 o'c. Midsy; pairs into Balrog; palm-mute friendly. Fellbeast V2 High Gain Fuzz — $200/$220. Gate ~12 o'c for gated, percussive fuzzstortion. All three on the board; Mithrandir and Valhalla arrived in Copper Hammertone. Owner has six Blackhawk pedals (two Balrogs), earmarked four more. Black/Blackened on Reverb; Copper via webstore. Recommendation: one Balrog; two add Basilisk; three add Fellbeast. So the first Blackhawk Pedal that won me over was the Balrog V3 High Gain Metal Distortion - actually being demo’d in a somewhat unusual fashion as a sludgy doom distortion - where it’s more typically deployed as a rather more classic pounding heavy metal distortion. I loved the grinding tones I heard in that first demo and that was my major gateway drug as such into the Blackhawk Amplifiers roster. I actually really love grungy and grinding high gain fuzzes and distortions - and the Balrog really awakened a latent need to get hold of some more on a similar level. I've related how tricky I found it initially to navigate through the Blackhawk range and figure out which of those pedals would best appeal to me, That is partly why I've collaborated so closely with Brooks Blackhawk - in order to get a proper overview and better understanding of each of those variants. Otherwise it can be rather an intimidating dense black sea of pedals covered in strange arcane symbols - and where it can initially be tricky to fully differentiate one from another - let alone decide upon a priority list of what appeals most.   Obviously - based partly on those conversations Brooks then added the Product Category Distinctions onto his Website - which hugely simplified and clarified the identification and selection process.
